input.china_demand: 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 Simplified Chinese * * languages with full audio support

input.china_demand: You and your partner awaken inside a mysterious Norček facility with little recollection of how you got there. Communicate, cooperate, and unravel the secrets in this asymmetrical co-op adventure. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow… On an expedition to save your fellow Explorers, you and your partner become the victims of bad timing, and are trapped beneath the ice of Antarctica. Once awakened, the world around the two of you is no longer the one you remember. With little recollection of what happened, you find yourselves inside a facility of Norček Industries, where the charismatic Director Kathleen Bowe is waiting for you. Her team was on the verge of a breakthrough, but they have mysteriously disappeared, leaving their work unfinished. With a global crisis looming, the Director turns to you and your partner to continue where they left off. To complete their work, you must take on a series of complex tasks throughout the facility. Often separated, you will rely solely on your walkie-talkies to communicate. Describe what you see, share what you discover, and combine your perspectives to solve the puzzles that stand in your way. But be cautious; the deeper you venture into the Norček facility, the more questions begin to surface. What is Norček trying to achieve? Why were you brought here? And what happened to those who came before you? Only together will you unravel the mysteries surrounding Norček Industries and discover the truth. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow. Key Features A shared adventure: When fate takes an unexpected turn, two Explorers find themselves trapped inside a mysterious facility. With only each other to rely on, they must uncover its secrets and decide what Tomorrow will hold. Asymmetrical co-op puzzling: No two Explorers experience the facility the same way. Trust your partner, communicate through your walkie-talkies, and combine your unique perspectives to solve puzzles that challenge the rules of time, gravity, and space. Two players, two distinct roles: You and your partner each have a different role to play, with your own high-tech tool at your disposal. Work together and use your equipment in creative ways to overcome obstacles that neither of you could face alone. A mystery in an imagined 80s future: Explore Norček Industries and uncover the secrets behind its experiments and missing research team. Journey through a retro-futuristic world brought to life by striking environments and a nostalgic synthwave soundtrack. The We Were Here Series Every game in the We Were Here Series is a standalone online co-op adventure – the stories are connected but you don’t need to play them in order. Playing with your friend and communicating well is key to the escape room series: asymmetrical puzzles give players different perspectives and can only be solved together. NOTE: This game is co-op only. It requires both players to have a working PC-compatible microphone and an internet connection. china_opportunities.value: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends. FOLLOW US X: @Infini_Fun About the Game Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history? Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. R ecruit Masters, Nurture New Talent : As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival. Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech : Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make. III. Transcend Gaming: Become a Cultural Icon When your works become classics and your company is hailed as legendary, your influence will extend far beyond the gaming industry. You will become a cultural symbol defining the next era. Cross-media Expansion, Build an IP Empire : Lead the film and TV adaptation of your legendary titles, collaborating with top directors to create box office hits. License or build physical theme parks based on your game worlds, turning them into pilgrimage sites for fans globally. Elevate Value, Impact Society : Partner with universities and medical institutions to develop serious educational games or therapeutic experiences. Use the power of games to create profound social value and earn respect that goes beyond commerce. Reach the Pinnacle, Achieve Immortality : Establish your own video game museum, found an award named after you, and have your design philosophy written into textbooks. You are no longer just a successful businessperson—you have become a part of gaming culture itself. Game Features Dynamic Story Generator : Every new game is a unique story. The personal dramas of employees, competitors' business secrets, and the birth of legends are all dynamically generated by your choices. Relatability Meets Relaxation : Authentically captures industry challenges like project delays, technical bottlenecks, and team conflicts—enough to make you smile wryly in recognition. The overall lighthearted and humorous tone makes strategizing and decision-making a genuine pleasure. Ultimate Freedom of Exploration : From game concepts to corporate strategy, talent management to business alliances—there is no single formula for success. Every path can lead to your own version of Rome. A Treasure Trove of Easter Eggs : The game is packed with countless Easter eggs referencing gaming history, industry jargon, and classic titles, waiting to be discovered and savored by true core players. input.china_demand: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter. Welcome to the U.R.C. — the Unknown Research Consortium. The operation is about to begin. Stay combat-ready. Explore anomalous zones — from abandoned facilities and deserted outposts to forests locked in eternal flame and deadly high-altitude snowfields. Scavenge weapons, medicine, gear, and supplies while recovering ancient artifacts, unknown biological samples, and hidden encrypted documents. Bring back valuable intel, then reach the Extraction Point and return to the Safe House before time runs out. The twisted species emerging within these zones are only one of the obstacles standing in your way. You will also encounter agents from rival factions, mercenaries, and madmen whose minds have been swallowed by the void. When order disappears, the deadliest threat is not always the beast in front of you. Above all else, remember the first rule of every operation: Survive. Use the Gunsmith system to turn whatever you can find into something deadly. Every unorthodox build is yours to test, and the answer will reveal itself the moment you pull the trigger — whether you have created a battlefield-dominating superweapon or a metal coffin that detonates in your hands. When dark violet corruption patterns begin to crawl across the weapon’s surface, it means the gun has broken free from traditional specifications. “Compatibility” no longer applies. You might craft an engineering miracle that defies logic. Or you might end up with a dangerous piece of scrap fit only for an accident report. Even after rigorous training and time spent adapting to this alien environment, an agent’s growth is never complete. Greater strength, agility, and firearm control help you carry more, move faster, and react before the threat does. Every sprint, strike, and shot sharpens your body, instincts, and weapon proficiency. Bring back resources, maintain your gear, reinforce your facilities, and turn that “junk” into another chance to survive. Never underestimate the value of logistics. Once you transform your Safe House into a fortress, your next step into the abyss will be steadier than the last. Venture into Dimensional Fragments alone, or form an exploration squad with up to three other U.R.C. agents for multiplayer missions. Close coordination can greatly improve your extraction rewards and survival odds. Here, watching each other’s backs is not just a virtue. It is essential for survival. input.china_demand: A pausable real time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat; It’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines. “The truth is... less than 1% of war is real fighting. The other 99% is just suffering in the trenches — from shellfire, hunger, disease, and rats.” — An unnamed soldier Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a tactical survival and outpost simulation management game driven by various unexpected events on the battlefield. The main inspirations come from Neo Scavenger, Gates of Hell, RimWorld. The story background is inspired by pivotal conflicts in modern history. You will take on the role of the only surviving officer in the company after an enemy airstrike, taking up the responsibility in a crisis, gathering the remnants, and leading the troops through battle after battle to break through the dilemma, gradually growing into an elite force. Gameplay Design It’s more important to play a bad hand well than to be dealt a good one. Through the high-altitude drone combat command platform, you cannot participate in combat personally, but you can observe the real-time situation on the battlefield and quickly update your combat deployments via the drone’s camera. However, there is still a time gap and human factors in the issuing and execution of orders. Sometimes, you must anticipate in advance or radically shift your approach. But plans never keep up with changes — perhaps you should be prepared for your operations to be disrupted. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is dedicated to expressing aspects rarely touched upon by other war games: Detailed classification of logistics work. Machine gun ammo belts must be assembled from loose rounds in the ammo workshop before they can be used by gunners; ingredients are cooked into hot meals in the field kitchen; the severely wounded undergo emergency surgery before being transported to the rear for treatment; fallen comrades are recovered, prepared, and sent back. Customizable armament. In war, the only constant is “change”, and that applies to machines too. Not every piece of armament can function like it came out of the factory. When there are no suitable replacement parts, or when you have two tanks each with different damages, “working” is the only requirement — if it can be fixed, it must not be scrapped! In addition, you can also modify your armament to add new functions to suit different battlefield environments. Soldiers who obey orders but retain individuality. Your soldiers execute combat orders strictly, but may also pick up loot amid the hail of bullets. Besides ammunition, their backpacks may also carry “junk” they can’t bear to discard — if deployed near a river, they might even bring back a big fish for the mess hall in the evening. Balanced nutrition, properly rationed. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare strongly encourages players to enhance the frontline living conditions of their troops in every possible way — and rations are a key part of that. In the game, you can recreate real-world rationing systems used across various theaters of war: rear-echelon logistics personnel receive standard provisions, while frontline combat units are kept well-fed and ready for action. If managing such details isn't your style, this aspect won’t penalize you or block your progress in combat operations. However, better-fed soldiers will fight more effectively and exhibit greater resistance to injuries and illness. *Plenty of protein makes soldiers stronger, vitamins help them fight off infections, a small snack adds a touch of dignity to dinner, and a drink can make even the blandest meal easier to swallow. Battlefield rescue — time is life. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare provides a detailed and smooth battlefield rescue experience. From emergency treatment on the field to the transfer of the wounded, to surgery at the aid point and medical evacuation — you need to quickly judge based on the situation: whether to risk using helicopters to evacuate from the combat zone, or play it safe and use armored vehicles for transport. Having the medical team accompany can also buy more time for the wounded. Although survival ultimately depends on fate, rest assured — Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare will not let your efforts go to waste. Game events with unique perspectives. Receive frontline journalists for interviews. As long as their safety is ensured, the closer they are to the front, the more valuable footage they can get — and the greater the rewards you’ll receive. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a game that tells a war story unique to you. Every action of each soldier under your command will be recorded. Even those who die heroically will be remembered by history. You can set a time range, and the system will automatically collect the combat records of troops during that period and compile them into a battle report, restoring your command orders through text. You can personally name each operation — yes, you are also a part of history. Visual Design In addition to gameplay design, Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare has gone to great lengths to enhance immersion through its visual design. Unit Icons The game's unit icons are based on real-world NATO military symbols. When a unit's equipment changes, the icon automatically updates to reflect its current configuration, accurately representing real-world military notation. You can freely customize different unit types to your liking. (Example: When a recon squad boards a pickup truck, its unit icon will change to that of a motorized recon squad.) Destructible Structures In Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare , buildings are composed of modular rooms that react dynamically to player actions. This means destruction is never the same—no two buildings will (probably...) collapse in exactly the same way. Program Design Multithreaded Optimization of the Pathfinding System You will experience Establish frontline outposts to store supplies and manpower arriving from the rear. Scavenge materials in the ruins of abandoned towns, and transform existing buildings into various military and logistics facilities. Assign soldiers to logistics positions, adjust work priorities and shifts, and automate the operation of the frontline outposts. Form various combat teams to construct your own combat system. Take building clusters as tactical points, relying on solid building cover to engage in tug-of-war battles with the enemy. Arrange logistics and transportation to ensure sufficient supplies to frontline positions. Evacuate the wounded — the faster they receive treatment, the more likely they are to survive. Call for off-field artillery or airstrike support to lay the foundation for infantry assaults. Clean the battlefield and collect spoils; recover the bodies of comrades — we leave no one behind! Recover enemy armament— you may choose to repair and reuse it. Take over special locations in the city (hospitals, factories, etc.) to enhance your logistics base with existing equipment. Adjust food rations to quickly restore morale after large battles. Gather ingredients locally and grow vegetables on wasteland to ensure balanced nutrition for your soldiers. Dig trenches and stockpile supplies to prepare for enemy counterattacks. Maintain your armament to ensure it won't fail in the next battle. Unlock new military policies and weapons to enhance your troops' combat capabilities. Explore new areas, push the frontlines, and face stronger enemies! input.china_demand: Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. Play through authentic movie moments in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode. Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode. In Story Mode, swap between Woody, Buzz, and Jessie as you play through iconic scenes from the film, including the train rescue, Operation Playtime, surviving the junkyard, and more. Harness each character's unique abilities, whether you need to swing on Woody’s pull string or use Buzz’s strength to throw the other toys long distances. You can even play in two-player co-op. Step out of Story Mode and into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. This fan-favorite, customizable mode drops you into the wild west of Woody’s Roundup. Like Story Mode, you play as Woody, Buzz, or Jessie, but in Toy Box Mode you can play however you want! Characters around town give you quests to complete, so you can earn gold and spend it on personalizing the town your way. Build, decorate and customize the buildings, dress up the townsfolk, and more. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also includes content that was previously restricted to certain versions of the game. Players can now play as the Evil Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode, and can access four additional Theme Packs to decorate their Toy Box. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also features upgraded graphics, resolution, and framerate. FEATURES - Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back a fan-favorite game. - Relive key moments from the movie in Story Mode from Andy's room to Sunnyside Daycare. - Swap between Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie, each of with different abilities you’ll need to complete each level. - Dive into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. Take on missions for your fellow toys, dress up the townsfolk, decorate buildings, and much more. - Play with a friend in local, two player co-op. Available in Story Mode or Toy Box Mode. - All versions now include previously exclusive content, such as the ability to play as Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode. input.china_demand: "An idle racing management game tailor-made for second screens. Perfect for 'desktop slacking,' watch your car auto-race while you work. No driving required—step behind the scenes as the boss to tune cars, manage drivers, and experience the pure joy of motorsport management!" nfinite R: Idle Racing is a racing idle management game tailor-made for car enthusiasts and those who love to sneak in a little gaming while working. Here, you don't need to tense up and focus on hitting the perfect racing line. Instead, you step into the shoes of a team's gold-medal tuner and mod shop boss. The game perfectly supports [Desktop Idling] during work hours, with an adaptive window that sits comfortably at the bottom of your screen. While you are typing code, writing reports, or browsing the web, your exclusive ride is automatically speeding along the edge of your screen with its engine roaring—continuously generating income for you without ever delaying your actual work. Say goodbye to the heavy grind and tense nerves! No stressful inputs are required. Check in occasionally, click a few times when you're free, and just enjoy the fun of the game. Development Plan Tuning & Simulation Management Start from a dilapidated garage and a beat-up old street racer, and gradually revive your custom car empire. Say goodbye to tedious stat crunching; the game offers the pure soul of car modification. Unlock more modification kits as you level up, which not only drastically boosts your car's performance but also evolves its badass appearance. Hire and manage workshop employees to build an efficient and lightning-fast workflow! Intense Idle Racing The cars drive fully automatically on idle throughout the race, never demanding your core focus. During your breaks, you can choose to actively intervene—by training racers, unleashing exclusive skills at critical moments, and pulling off extreme overtakes. Instantly take control of the race's pacing and use your strategy to significantly boost your win rate and tournament earnings. Deep Modification System Satisfy your ultimate craving for machinery and speed! Dive deep into your vehicle's powertrain and chassis tuning, from engine enhancements to transmission system upgrades. Not only are there hardcore internal performance boosts, but there is also a massive variety of widebody kits, custom spoilers, and personalized wheels for you to mix and match. Every meticulous tweak allows your race car to show off a truly unique stance on the track. Collect More Vehicles As your garage continues to expand, you will have the opportunity to unlock and collect a massive roster of classic race cars across different styles. Continuously enrich your garage collection, assign the most suitable cars to compete based on specific track requirements and personal preferences, and watch them roar past on your secondary screen. Rich Character System Recruit and train highly talented racers and tuning shop mechanics. Every driver has an exclusive driving style and unique skills that can save the day on the track; meanwhile, excellent workshop staff and operations specialists can massively improve prep efficiency and offline income. Strategically balance your team lineup to keep your crew running like a well-oiled machine. Dynamic Weather System Your racing journey will never be monotonous. The game introduces a rich, dynamic weather system. Whether it's a crystal-clear street or a neon-lit rainy night, the game delivers completely different visual atmospheres, making every idle lap feel immersive and fresh. The diverse track landscapes are not only a visual feast but also pose unique challenges to your vehicle's grip, horsepower output, and your driver's skills. input.china_demand: Play solo. Plan as a team. Build a Three Kingdoms deck and join an AI ally in 2v2 battles. Share the field, set up counterplays and adapt to changing weather. Collect foil and alternate-art cards, unlock bond stories, and bring new combinations into your next match. Play solo. Plan as a team. Thirteen Provinces · Hanren is a single-player strategy card game inspired by the Three Kingdoms. Choose a leader, build your deck and join an AI ally against two AI opponents. You share the field and a pool of Strategy Points. Commit everything now, or leave room for your partner's next move? Every play asks you to think beyond your own turn. You can also face an AI opponent in 1v1 to put your deck and decisions to the test. Make your next move with the heroes of the Three Kingdoms Choose from ten leaders and build your deck with Soldiers, Generals, Commands and Schemes. Establish a line of soldiers, summon generals to lead the attack, and set hidden Schemes for a counterplay. You decide when to bring out your ace and where to commit your resources. An opponent's move can trigger the answer you prepared earlier. Set up your counterplays and let them activate when their conditions are met, disrupting the enemy's plans. Collect and craft new cards, then take your next combination back into battle. When the weather turns, change your plan As turns pass, spring gives way to summer, autumn and winter, bringing conditions that reshape your plans. In fog, combat cards summoned that turn cannot attack. A blizzard temporarily prevents both sides from fighting. Read the current weather and its subtle signs, then decide whether to press the attack, hold your cards or rebuild your line. Cards to treasure. Companions to remember. Collect foils and alternate artwork, pair your deck with card backs, playmats and deck boxes, and choose a new look for your leader. Give your collection a style of its own. Fight together and meet the requirements to unlock bond stories between leaders, along with a dedicated story for Renxin and Lü Lingqi. After battle, return to the Memory Album to revisit the chapters you have read and the moments you shared. Make progress at your own pace Challenge different opponent decks in the solo and team AI ladders, refine your strategy and grow your collection. Three permanent progression seasons, First Campaign, Clash at Guandu and Red Cliffs: Flames on the River, each keep their own progress. There are no expiry timers or scheduled resets. Play battles to work towards rewards, and unlock premium reward tracks with in-game coins. Card packs, cosmetics and passes use resources earned through play. The current version has no real-money in-game purchases. Players and languages This game is for one human player. In 1v1, you face an AI opponent. In 2v2, you and an AI ally face two AI opponents. Online multiplayer and local two-player controls are not supported. Interface and reading text support Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English, with Mandarin and English voices. input.china_demand: Two players, one couch, one tower that talks back. Climb an endless roguelite tower in split-screen co-op or solo - your weapons fire themselves, so you fight with positioning. Evolve 20 weapons, rank up transformations that never cap, and face a Warden every fifth floor while the Tower mocks you. "Experiment 4051 begins. I wiped the previous 4050 into the stairwell." - the Tower EARLY ACCESS: the climb is fully playable today - solo or co-op, five zones, no top floor. During Early Access we plan to add new monsters for the deep zones and more Wardens with their own models, and to tune the balance around your climbs. The details are in the Early Access section on this page. ONE TOWER. TWO PLAYERS. NO PATIENCE. TOWERMOUTH is a couch co-op roguelite climb. Two of you share one screen, one PC and one very rude tower. Every floor is a room full of things that want you gone. Clear it, take the stairs, and let the Tower tell you exactly what it thought of your performance. There is no top floor. YOUR WEAPONS FIRE THEMSELVES You never click to attack. Weapons pick their own targets and swing on their own rhythm, so the whole fight is about where you stand, who you body-block and when you commit. 20 weapons - CLUB, KATANA, CROSSBOW, BLUNDERBUSS, ICE STAFF, a FRYING PAN, an actual FISH - each with its own reach and cadence, and most of them leave a mark: bleed, shock, sunder or splash. WEAPONS EVOLVE Take the same weapon again and it does not pile up in a corner of your inventory - it upgrades. Every tier is +40% damage and a visibly bigger, meaner version of itself. A tier-3 SCYTHE looks nothing like the one you started with. FIVE COPIES CHANGE THE RULES Stack five copies of an effect card and it stops being an item. STORM RING becomes LIGHTNING ROD. BLAST FIST becomes FUSE FIST. VAMPIRE becomes BLOOD WEB. THORNS becomes THORN GARDEN. EAGLE EYE becomes ECHO. Then keep stacking: every five more copies is a new rank - more rods, longer echo chains, longer bomb chains, a wider web, more thorns - and once the visible upgrades run out, every rank still adds +25% damage. There is no cap. "That is not a build anymore. That is weather." - the Tower STAND CLOSE. FUSE. Any two active transformations fuse: each one's trigger sets off a small burst of the other. Ten named fusions - STORM ECHO, THUNDER FUSE, BLOOD BOMB, SHRAPNEL, LIVE WIRE and more. Solo, you fuse your own two. In co-op, your partner's transformations count too while you stand within 9 m of each other - so the strongest build in the room can be the two of you, standing uncomfortably close. "Stay close, you two. It is disgusting. It works." - the Tower BUILDS YOU CAN SEE ON YOUR BODY Dozens of items, augments and curses, and the loud ones change how your character looks. RED FLASK reddens your skin. STORM RING wraps you in arcane light. ROTTEN HEART trades 16 max HP for +14% damage and rots you visibly. Trade-offs are the point: GLASS CANNON, BERSERK, GAMBLER, GOLDEN SHACKLES - and rule-benders like GRAVEDIGGER'S PACT and PRANK INSURANCE that mess with the Tower's own rules. Three pieces of a family earn you its title, and 16 synergies are waiting to be found. You can read a player's build by looking at them. PICK FAST. READ EVERYTHING. Level-ups, ultimate picks, rewards and the market use stone-tablet card screens: one clear text size across every card, a pointer in your own color, and in co-op a full description panel for each player. Every card says exactly what it does, with its numbers, in all 15 languages. Cards show what they are building toward ("3/5 → ECHO"), weapon cards compare against the weaker weapon you hold, and the pause screen draws your whole build as a skill tree - one per player. ULTIMATES WITH NO INDOOR VOICE Eleven of them: BLACK HOLE, METEOR RAIN, ICE AGE, THUNDER GOD, APOCALYPSE, GHOST SWARM and friends. One button, one very large opinion. A WARDEN EVERY FIVE FLOORS Four fast floors, then a wall. 150 named Wardens stand between floor 5 and floor 750, each with signature attacks drawn from eight - rock rain, slams, summons, lava, volleys, novas and worse. They telegraph hard, hit harder and enrage when you hurt them. The sprint floors are the breath; the fifth is the test. THE COLLECTOR From floor 15, every fourth Warden is THE COLLECTOR. It turns up with copies of your own weapons floating around it, and the stronger your build, the tougher it gets. You are, in a very real sense, fighting your own choices. "THE COLLECTOR. It liked your build so much it kept a copy." - the Tower THE GAME TELLS YOU THE MOVE When something is about to kill you, your half of the screen says what to do about it - one line with your own button, only in that moment, and rarely. RED RING - DASH OUT. SHIELD IN FRONT - HIT IT FROM BEHIND. When your partner goes down, the alert names the right move: dash out of the slam, drag them away from the Warden, or stay close to revive. A Warden's health bar marks where it will enrage, its enrage blast warns you before it lands, and the pad only rumbles when something on screen deserves it. SPLIT-SCREEN THAT ISN'T AN AFTERTHOUGHT Both players get a real camera, a real build and a real shop - not one lead and one passenger. Two gamepads, a gamepad plus the keyboard, or both of you on one keyboard - or solo when nobody is around. When one of you drops, the other stands close to revive - or grabs them and drags them away from the Warden. No online, no accounts, no netcode - but Steam Remote Play Together lets a friend join from their own couch. Sit down and play. FOUR WAYS TO SUFFER EASY, NORMAL, HARD and CHAOS. input.china_demand: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage — scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive. WORKS: Motorsport Factory is a top-down tycoon sim about everything that happens before a racing car reaches the circuit. Manage a motorsport team from the ground up: staff, facilities, car design and development while trying to stay competitive on a limited budget. Secure sponsors, hire mechanics, source parts and keep the operation running long enough to make it to race day. Five tiers of motorsport stand between your workshop and the being the most prestigious team in motorsport. Progress is not a straight climb - it’s a long-term struggle of financial pressure, technical setbacks and outperforming better-funded rivals. You manage the operation that makes the racing possible. Build the car. Prepare the spares. Manage the crew. Get the right driver in the seat. Load the truck. Get everything out of the factory and to the circuit before the departure deadline. While you wait at the factory the racing happens, watch the timing screens and wait. When the results come in your work begins again worn parts, crash damage and everything you learned about the car. Your crew goes to work. Deliveries arrive. Builders get back to work on the new section of the garage. Every job takes time. Every job needs someone to do it. Where you put things, who you hire, how your workshop is laid out and what your crew is doing right now all matter. The factory isn't a menu. It's a working place. Each part has a story. Each part has a lifespan. A brand new part at race one is not the same at the end of a season. Performance drops off, wear accumulates and eventually a part will fail. Run it too hard and repair it too much and it won't perform the same again. You can design parts for performance, endurance or reliability but getting the right balance to cover all three can be impossible Every part has a breaking point. Every part has a finite mileage lifespan. Every part has a performance drop-off that only reveals itself under real conditions. The better your facilities and the stronger your technical staff, the more of the truth you can uncover.
